==Description==
'''Necromancer's Tome''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 28 of the premium [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] track. It was made by c4rpye. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

When used, the player will start to hold a [[Necromancer]]'s tome. With it, they will create a circle around themselves which summons in three [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeletons]]. The will then surround the player by walking around them. Occasionally, the player will grab one of the [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeletons]], during which the [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeletons]] will retaliate by jumping on their head, freeing the captured [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeleton]]. When unequipped, the player will seal away the [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeletons]].

It had a cost of {{GumDrops|760}} or {{Robux|92}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|9,725}} or {{Robux|1,863}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|116}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|2,343}}.
